handoffSay: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Carolina Liang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Carolina Liang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lamar blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Fine Woodworking (Level 1). Joints that hold without nails: mortise, tenon, and the humble dovetail.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Carolina Liang, 14 days. The mantle passes to Lamar Tkachenko.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lamar Tkachenko, 24 — a carpenter.
The fire knew Lamar — solid ground, earned at this fire.
📜 Carolina's book stays open on the table: one promise unkept — Jorge — help Jorge with their injury. The promises died with their maker; the needs didn't. What you do about them is yours to decide.
